basis: Participant role statement approved by the user; not inferred from Git authorship or commit counts.

members.name: Egor Serov
members.statement: Implemented the MLP and shared training pipeline; organized controlled source-by-head comparisons; investigated decoder width and model capacity; and prepared the reproducible experimental protocol.
members.slide_summary: MLP and training pipeline; controlled comparisons; decoder width and capacity.

members.name: Kirill Frolov
members.statement: Prepared synthetic data and PCA analyses; examined the original evaluation criteria and added R2 and Variogram Score diagnostics; analyzed archived forecasts, checked numerical consistency, and consolidated the final materials.
members.slide_summary: Data and PCA; R2 / Variogram Score; forecast checks and final synthesis.

members.name: Daniil Koblov
members.statement: Implemented and validated S4 and structured forecasting models; adapted them to joint multivariate prediction; compared source distributions and investigated how findings transfer from synthetic to real data.
members.slide_summary: S4 and structured heads; joint multichannel forecasting; transfer to real data.

members.name: Vasilii Lyamin
members.statement: Studied whitening and normalization; analyzed head Jacobians, kernel settings, and result sensitivity; investigated mechanisms behind model differences, visualized diagnostics, and formulated the limitations of the conclusions.
members.slide_summary: Whitening and normalization; Jacobian / kernel diagnostics; interpretation and plots.
